Start script-level logging when available

Source: R/logging_helpers.R
start_script_logging.Rd

Starts script timing and print capture when the PICARD logger has been configured. When the script already runs inside a managed PICARD context, the function becomes a no-op so the same incipit can be used both standalone and inside the pipeline.

Usage

start_script_logging(
  script_name = NULL,
  capture_prints = TRUE,
  capture_messages = TRUE,
  envir = parent.frame()
)

Arguments

script_name

Optional label for the script in the log. Defaults to the current sourced filename when available.

capture_prints

Logical; if TRUE (default), capture printed output.

capture_messages

Logical; if TRUE (default), also capture messages and warnings when capturing prints.

envir

Environment used to store the ownership flag. Defaults to parent.frame().

Value

Invisibly returns TRUE when this call started logging, otherwise FALSE.
